archive_timing_interpretation: Encoding and full verification execute outside the write transaction. These are individual controlled samples, not a distribution or a stable speedup claim; the new total includes preparation, deliberate late-ingest interleaving and exact-CAS commit. Timings from the parallel race/PG run are preserved as observed.

recovery.cursor: complete replay window only, preserving all same-timestamp inputs
recovery.parent_child_interruption: exact output receipts committed with inbox and state; duplicate parent resumes child traversal
recovery.rollup_tail: phase=rollups; progress=1; business_state=finalizing while active; every rollup write transaction checks business version; cancellation/new generation stop further commits
recovery.cross_day_proof: 15 committed rollups preserved through cancellation; same identities retried to 24; live state versions and exact replay output receipts unchanged
recovery.process_kill: Actual child SIGKILL; official River rescue with injected attempted_at age 120s vs rescue threshold 90s; second attempt resumes 3 exact evaluations including two same-timestamp inputs, final counter 7

initial_failed_attempts.resolution: The compatibility endpoint test expected exactly 3 migrations; changed expectation to the current manifest maximum and reran API/full suite
SQLite crash test used RFC3339 attempted_at instead of the official driver SQL timestamp format; corrected injected timestamp, actual SIGKILL/rescue then passed
Fixture SourceSequence literal was int64; corrected to uint64; no production arithmetic change
Fixture definition lacked required group_id; added factory group and then actual SIGKILL recovery passed
Whole-compose assertion encountered a pre-existing Kafka healthcheck generator mismatch; narrowed this PostgreSQL test to postgres services and all volume references, notified coordinator about Kafka
PostgreSQL-only user fixture omitted the required Name; added Name: "Operator". Exact HTTP concurrency test then passed, and its successful evidence is retained.

review_followups.details: Authenticated Tasks.RetryJob reuses the mapped task/River/replay identity, window and cursor through the same ChangeTask transaction as /tasks retry. Unmapped failed legacy jobs are adopted once with authorization/version guards, task insert and audit in the same transaction. HTTP 202 Job is preserved.

Definitions.Store uses DefinitionRepository; Tasks.Store uses TaskRepository; authorizationReader uses DocumentQueries; definitioncommit uses Repository. tasks.Service.Store uses Repository; Backend adds the composition-time official River client factory. SQL/driver choice is in Store.

TestRealThreeReplicaCoordination, TestActualOrganizationProcessPullAndCrashIsolation and TestNativeCalculatedFieldAlarmAndRetention remain explicitly classified in conditional_skips. Related native evidence is linked; no user exclusion is inferred.
